items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I had an offer to go with Teddy

ctx.x: I didn't particularly want to go with a band like Chick's. They weren't making any money. They weren't making any money at all and I had been accustomed to making money.
I had an offer to go with Teddy--I don't remember getting an offer to go with Chick Webb, but I do know that one of the offers I got didn't interest me at all.
Wait a minute--I did get an offer from Chick Webb; that's when I said I wasn't thinking about leaving Trent's band.
